evals.prompt: Create a catchy Taglish social post to promote this script. Topic slug: baon-meal-prep. Script: 'Busy ka sa school? Sa video na ito, ipapakita namin ang simpleng paraan para magplano ng baon: pumili ng meals for the week, gumawa ng grocery list, at maghanda ng ilang ingredients in advance. Save mo ang video para mabalikan bago mag-grocery.' Save the post by default. No platform specified.
evals.expected_output: An engaging but platform-neutral Taglish promotional post based only on the script, with no invented savings/health claims, saved to `docs/post/baon-meal-prep.md`.
